'''Catalog terminals''' were used in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Jedi Archives]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. To use it, one would have to insert a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] to log in and look something up. [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] used one while she was on Coruscant disguised as [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Nalia Adollu]].
